svg.text: Three-Tier BAS Architecture: Management, Supervisory Field Panels & Room Controllers
1. Management Level Network (MLN) — Operator Workstations & Enterprise Servers (B-AWS)
Siemens Desigo CC • Siemens APOGEE Insight • Trane Tracer Synchrony
Campus Graphics, Long-Term Trend Historian, Alarm Routing (RENO/Email/SMS), Global Calendars
2. Automation Level Network (ALN / BACnet/IP / BACnet/SC) — Supervisory & Plant Field Panels (B-BC)
Desigo PXC4 / PXC5 / PXC7 / PXC100-E.D • APOGEE PXC Compact / Modular / MBC • Tracer SC+
Central Plant & AHU Control (PPCL / CFC / TGP2), Local Schedules & Trend Buffers, MS/TP & FLN Routing
3. Floor / Field Level Network (FLN / BACnet MS/TP / KNX PL-Link) — Terminal & Unitary Controllers (B-ASC / B-AAC)
Desigo DXR2 • APOGEE PTEC / ATEC / 570 Lab • Phoenix PBC / Traccel • Viconics VT7000/8000 • Symbio • York SSE
VAV Boxes, Laboratory Fume Hoods & Venturi Valves, Fan Coils, Packaged Rooftops, Chiller Control Centers
